lede: The Fourth of July weekend is the main event this week, with Better Than Ezra, the Red White and Blues celebration in Mountain Village, a drone show, and a full slate of music and community happenings running through the holiday. On the government side, the county has three meetings scheduled for July 8 — including two special sessions and a work session — but none have posted agendas yet, and the Town's Open Space and Ecology commissions are in the same boat.
